updates.title: Game Updates from every official channel
updates.summary: The Game Updates tab no longer relies on Steam alone. It now merges the official marvelrivals.com news index (patch notes, balance posts, dev diaries, announcements), the official Steam news feed, and the official YouTube channel, labelling each item with its source and folding Steam mirrors into the canonical official-site post.
updates.note: Esports match VODs are filtered out and videos are capped, so articles stay at the top of the feed.

updates.title: Game Updates tab
updates.summary: Added a Game Updates tab that lists the latest official Marvel Rivals patch notes, balance posts, and dev posts with dates and direct links. The feed is refreshed automatically from the official Steam news channel.
updates.note: Also added a metadata-only Season 10.5 snapshot for the 2026-10-22 update.

updates.title: Season 10 Team-Up dataset
updates.summary: Added Gorr the God Butcher, his directional Team-Up links to Hela and Venom, updated Season 10 effects and numbers, and regenerated all team composition formats.

updates.title: Season 10.5 Team-Up dataset
updates.summary: Enabled the Season 10.5 snapshot with updated Team-Up effects, balance numbers, and Alchemax Headquarters map data.

updates.title: More Team-Up mini games
updates.summary: Added Complete the Team and Guess the Hero modes with daily and random play, progressive verified clues, Team-Up effect details, scoring, LocalStorage progress, spoiler-free sharing, and a compact homepage game launcher.

updates.title: Season 9.5 Team-Up dataset
updates.summary: Unlocked the Season 9.5 snapshot with The Hood as an active Vanguard, updated directional Team-Up effects, and regenerated every team composition set.

updates.title: Directional Team-Up Path game
updates.summary: Added a lightweight path puzzle where players connect heroes using valid one-way Team-Up relationships and compare their result with the shortest route.

updates.title: Team Browser and role filters
updates.summary: Renamed the site to Marvel Rivals Team-Up Planner, added role composition filters, clearer comp labels, and a more compact Team Browser row layout with right-aligned sharing.

updates.title: Team-Up effect display
updates.summary: Team-Up paths now default to compact mode, with official effect numbers available through global and per-card show/hide controls.

updates.title: Shareable team cards
updates.summary: Generated teams can be exported as social-ready PNG cards with heroes, role format, patch, and active Team-Ups.

updates.title: Duo Planner visibility
updates.summary: Player Pools is now Duo Planner, with a clearer duo CTA, example pools, sample setup, and more visible Saved Teams.

updates.title: Google Analytics added
updates.summary: GA4 now tracks page views and key tool interactions for Team Browser, Team Planner, Player Pools, feedback, and social links.

updates.title: Team Planner and Player Pools
updates.summary: Team Builder is now Team Planner, with prominent Draft and Player Pools workflows for duo planning.
updates.note: Shoutout to David for suggesting two-player hero pools.

updates.title: Pool Comps
updates.summary: Player Pools can now surface full fully enhanced teams that include heroes from both pools.

updates.title: Official Team-Up effect data
updates.summary: Team-Up ability names and effect summaries now use official Marvel Rivals hero pages where available.

updates.title: Saved comps and feedback
updates.summary: Save local Team Planner comps, load them later, copy share links, and send site feedback.

updates.title: Fully enhanced team browser
updates.summary: Browse all generated fully enhanced teams, filter by heroes, and compare unrestricted or 2-2-2 results.
